Rolling pre-release from `master`.

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `Telescope-windows.zip` | Windows bundle. Extract and run `TelescopeDesktop.exe` - self-contained, includes adb and UnityCapture. |
| `Telescope-linux.tar.gz` | Linux bundle. Extract and run `./start.sh` - installs deps and launches. |
| `Telescope.apk` | Android app. |
